abstract_algebra.subject: abstract_algebra
abstract_algebra.description: Abstract algebra focusing on group theory structures, including orders of elements and subgroups, Lagrange's theorem, homomorphisms, normal subgroups, factor groups, and isomorphism theorems. Encompasses symmetric groups, permutation properties, integral domains, fields of quotients, and applications of Euler's phi function in structural analyses.

anatomy.subject: anatomy
anatomy.description: Anatomy specializing in head and neck structures (parotid gland, maxillary sinus, tonsillar tissue), respiratory system (lung lobes, trachea), cardiovascular auscultation, cartilage function, emissary veins, sinus pain referral, and pharyngeal development with innervation correlates.

astronomy.subject: astronomy
astronomy.description: Astronomy covering planetary differentiation, heat dissipation, and atmospheric loss mechanisms (e.g., Mercury). Integrates solar system formation theories, lunar maria origins, orbital mechanics, blackbody radiation principles, and celestial dynamics, including surface mapping techniques, Coriolis effects, and comet tail behavior.

business_ethics.subject: business_ethics
business_ethics.description: Business ethics integrates corporate governance frameworks—encompassing director disqualification laws, agency relationships, and OECD-identified challenges—with ethical theories, workplace ethics addressing emotional exploitation, sustainability initiatives, and business-civil society collaboration models, alongside stakeholder communication barriers and corporate social responsibility dynamics.

college_computer_science.subject: college_computer_science
college_computer_science.description: College computer science covering symbol tables, hashing, page replacement policies, recursive computation, and efficient data structures. Includes Church's thesis, reference counting, automata theory, logic programming evaluation, distributed operating systems, and matrix complexity analysis.

high_school_chemistry.subject: high_school_chemistry
high_school_chemistry.description: High school chemistry covering atomic structure, periodic trends, chemical bonding, thermodynamics, reaction kinetics, equilibrium, and solution chemistry. Topics include electron configurations, Lewis structures, enthalpy, Gibbs free energy, buffer systems, stoichiometry, solubility, and experimental error analysis in gas reactions.

high_school_geography.subject: high_school_geography
high_school_geography.description: High school geography integrates human and physical geographic principles, emphasizing central place theory, demographic transition stages, primary economic activities, migration drivers, continentality effects, and distance decay. It examines urbanization processes, population distribution, cultural diffusion, political geography, and environmental interactions, incorporating frameworks like possibilism and theories of religious and linguistic spread.

jurisprudence.subject: jurisprudence
jurisprudence.description: Jurisprudence encompasses normative theories (Natural Law, Soft Positivism), retributive justice, Benthamite codification, feminist critiques ('women question'), Critical Race Theory and democratic ideals, comparative legal analysis, and debates on sovereignty, legal delegation, and economic analysis of law.

world_religions.subject: world_religions
world_religions.description: World religions scholarship encompassing Islamic jurisprudence (Shari'ah), Sikh guruship and temple architecture, early Christian ecclesial roles, Reformation theology, Buddhist North American adaptation, and Jain meditative practices, with broader coverage of warrior ethics, apocalyptic movements, Daoist philosophy, and historical religious discourse in Asia and the West.

formal_logic.subject: formal_logic
formal_logic.description: Formal logic encompasses propositional and predicate logic, including symbolization of natural language, conditional propositions, and truth tables for equivalence, contradiction, and argument validity. It addresses quantified statements and consistency analysis via indirect truth tables.
